Metadata.description: Find fashion products, materials and tools in Cambodia — and the shops that sell them.

Footer.tagline: A free, open-source, non-profit directory for fashion lovers in Cambodia.

Home.title: Find fashion products and the shops that sell them
Home.intro: Fabrics, clothing, accessories, tools, supplies and services — from markets in Phnom Penh to workshops across all 25 provinces.
Home.step1Text: Look for a product, a material or a service.
Home.step2Text: See which shops carry it and where they are.
Home.step3Text: Get directions, call or message the shop.
Home.contributeText: This directory is built by the community. Add a shop you know — no account or coding needed.
